notes.title: SAND | May Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/5207e26c16a61750d418845d76e84781dea1f2a9.png[/img]

Servus Scavengers!

With the announcement that SAND is coming to consoles earlier this week at the tinyBuild Connect, we thought it was only fair we give some updates to our PC players on what's going on at the Hologryph HQ and how development is coming along!

So today, we asked Maksym, the head of studio at Hologryph what he and the team are doing and how SAND is shaping up. Let's take a look at what he had to say...

[h3]What are the current focuses for the development team at this stage?[/h3]

[b]Currently, the team is focusing on three main areas:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Throughout April and May, we created many prototypes and searched for a final gameplay form that would address the issues we identified with your help during the last playtest. In the coming months, we’ll be finalizing the elements that passed internal testing and building balance around the new set of features.
[*] Optimization and bug fixing.
[*] Porting the game to PS5 and Xbox Series (together with support from an external studio). The external studio is handling most of the work. Our involvement is limited to providing guidance on project structure, and occasionally doing tasks that are significantly faster for us to complete. This does not affect the release timeline for the PC version.
[/olist]
[h3]Do you have any new/unannounced content or features in the works?[/h3]

We have a number of new features currently in development. Not all of them will pass internal testing, so I can’t talk about all of them just yet.

What you can expect in the playtest:

[olist]
[*] [b]Weapon Modifications [/b]– Different weapons will have variations that can be crafted or found during gameplay.
[*] [b]Turret Deployment[/b] – You'll be able to place and remove turrets during an expedition, which ties in with the next point. 
[*] [b]Turret Conditions[/b] – Turrets will come in various states, ranging from “rusty” to “fresh off the shelf.” The condition affects certain turret characteristics, such as rotation speed and reload time.
[/olist]
[h3]How are optimizations coming along/what has been done?[/h3]

As part of the console porting process, we’re currently optimizing the game for launch on Xbox Series S, which will also result in stable fps on many PCs with similar performance levels.

At this stage, the optimization process has touched nearly every aspect of the game:
[list]
[*] How the terrain is generated, stored in memory, and unloaded
[*] Trampler compartment models, including the number and quality of their LODs
[*] Visual effects like reactor smoke or explosions from destroyed Trampler units
[*] Character animation system
[*] Loot generation system for islands and points of interest
[*] Network data format for certain systems
[*] And some more extremely cool stuff we're not ready to share just yet, but we'll show you in the near future...
[/list]
And of course, the work is still ongoing...

[h3]What has changed lately from previous playtests?[/h3]

[list]
[*] New islands and partially reworked old ones
[*] New types of firearms + a grenade
[*] Crafting stations on certain islands, and a crafting compartment for the Trampler. Plus a wide variety of crafting resources scattered across the map
[*] Ability to swap out cannons during an expedition
[*] Many cannon variations, including several [b][REDACTED][/b]-grade cannons
[*] New compartments
[*] A progression system that gradually unlocks access to more advanced compartments
[*] An orbital station shop where you can sell your findings and buy basic expedition supplies
[*] A loot distribution system after each expedition to ensure everyone gets what they need
[*] You can name your Trampler now
[*] Boost rods that temporarily accelerate the Trampler, helping you escape pursuit—or close the gap on enemies
[*] [b][REDACTED][/b]—diverse, powerful, and mysterious
[/list]
[h3]Finally, can we expect another playtest before launch?[/h3]

That’s the plan! We hope to have a playtest this summer to show off everything we’ve been working on the last few months, but you’ll have to wait a little longer for some more firm details on that. 

You can sign up for any closed or open playtests on the Steam page right now though, and you’ll be notified directly via Steam when they go live.

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Sign up for the playtest now and wishlist SAND on Steam now to be notified when it launches on Steam![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431300/Sand/

Come and join us on our social media pages to keep yourself up to date with all the news and updates for SAND or join the discussion over on Discord now!

notes.title: SAND | March Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/96e9beb9f368555f60171d527d874b27ccf3540f.jpg[/img]
Hello Scavengers!

With the Closed and Open Playtests and announcement of SAND launching into Early Access on April 3rd, February was a pretty crazy month for all of us here at tinyBuild and Hologryph and there's no signs of slowing down any time soon!

As the Early Access launch approaches, and with all the feedback, suggestions and reports from the recent beta still fresh in everyones minds, we wanted to give you all an update on what we're working on behind the scenes and what to expect from SAND when you all arrive back on Sophie in April.

So let's jump into it...

[h3]Optimization:[/h3]

While we made a lot of major improvements in this field between the Steam Next Fest demo last year and the recent open playtest, we still saw a lot of reports of performance issues and general disappointment at the current levels of optimization, but rest assured we hear you and we are doing everything we can to address these complaints ahead of the launch into Early Access.

[u][b]Here are some of the key areas we're working on right now[/b][/u]

[u]Inventory System Overhaul:[/u] 

We're reworking how inventory functions to reduce the number of client-server requests, which should help with responsiveness and performance.

[u]Occlusion & Object Unloading:[/u] 

Objects that players aren't actively seeing will now be unloaded more efficiently, reducing unnecessary rendering.

[u]Raycast Improvements:[/u] 

Various enhancements to how the game handles raycasts for better performance.

Optimization is a continuous process, we appreciate all the feedback we've received on this and you can be certain that we are going to continue improving it in the lead up to and throughout Early Access.

[h3]Quality of Life (QOL):[/h3]

We saw a lot of feedback from players who found it challenging to understand certain elements of SAND, so we're putting an increased focus on improving the UI/UX for easier and more intuitive navigation while also working to make the trampler editor easier to understand and more accessible for players.  

We're also working on new systems to help newer players understand the goals of the game, how to play and what to do. This will act as a precursor to a full tutorial we have planned and hope to introduce further down the line.

In addition, we'll be making some refinements for the general in game user experience to ensure a more enjoyable, immersive and rewarding experience:

[list]
[*] Improving the shooting mechanics for better combat responsiveness.
[*] Players will be able to consume food to recover health
[*] Adding more details on the extraction process, ensuring that players are aware of what needs to be done to properly extract their loot safely.
[*] A ton of general balancing adjustments for mounted weapons and explosives
[*] Reworking the start of expeditions with an improved dropship sequence.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/449b8a587ba36291051fcff1b4279e5d78e379de.jpg[/img]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]

We're also working away on implementing some popular community requests that we saw during recent playtests, which we hope to have at least early iterations of available upon the Early Access launch:

[b]Progression Tree & Unlockable Compartments:[/b] Players will be able to unlock new compartments, opening up more customization and progression options.
[b]Buried Treasure:[/b]  Keen eyed players will be able to locate and uncover buried loot in several locations around the map with the aid of a good old shovel
[b]Crafting System:[/b] Crafting will play a larger role in gameplay, introducing more survival and resource management mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/d91f41f03435fc040f5221cabdfc5e88cbe31ea6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Beyond Early Access Launch:[/h3]

Of course, this is just a fraction of what's going on behind the scenes and we have a ton more plans for how we plan to grow, improve and expand the game over the course of Early Access. Obviously we'll have a comprehensive roadmap on launch, but for a brief insight into some of our planned additions:

[list]
[*] More trampler compartments (crafting station, medical station, searchlight)
[*] New weapons and combat options (melee weapons, rocket launcher)
[*] Expanded crafting and industry systems
[*] New islands and biomes (desert anomalies, more diverse environments)
[*] Character improvements (customization, armor visualization, female characters)
[*] Enhanced multiplayer and communication systems (emotion-ping system, lobby system rework)
[*] Technical improvements (optimization, bug fixes, controller support, expanded localization)
[*] World and immersion upgrades (Sandstorms, companions system, achievements, expedition start cinematic)
[/list]

Keep an eye out for the comprehensive roadmap closer to launch for more details on where we're planning on taking SAND!

[hr][/hr]

What's most important right now is that you're all aware that your feedback has been heard, and that we're doing everything we can to ensure that SAND not only meets, but exceeds all of your expectations on launch and beyond. And of course, we're extremely grateful for all of your feedback, support and participation in our betas these last few months.

Wishlist SAND on Steam now to be notified when it launches into Early Access on April 3rd 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1431300/Sand/

Come and join us on our social media pages to keep yourself up to date with all the news and updates for SAND or join the discussion over on Discord now!

notes.title: SAND | November Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/f42ec25c1d429c3f087e15bdfe5d777a616494df.jpg[/img]

Hello Everybody,

With an intense few weeks now behind us, following the launch of the first SAND playtest that saw over 200,000 of you taking your first steps on Sophie, we wanted to give you all an update of how development on SAND is coming along and share some insights into what the team has been working on lately!

But before we get into it, we want to offer a huge thank you to all who participated, reported bugs, made suggestions and shared feedback. We are studying all of your propositions and ideas and adjusting our plans and priorities with them firmly in mind. 

It was a great experience for us and we are going to use all of your input to ensure an even better experience for you in SAND next time we invite you all back into the game! 

[h3]Optimization[/h3]

First of all, we heard you, we know optimization needs to be addressed and performance improved and we are actively working on optimization to make your experience smoother. 

Our optimization process is currently deeply related to general visual improvements. And here's a look at our work-in-progress screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/61a8564cdcea6b71fc3743f0a3c2d689227958c2.png[/img]

Of course, we are working on other optimization methods alongside this, this was just the easiest to show off visually!

[h3]Servers and server stability[/h3]

Secondly, in our pipeline a lot of server communication changes. So as some of you may be aware, our servers were inexplicably shut down, and therefore made the game totally inaccessible in the middle of the NEXT Fest. 

This was a huge disappointment for us and of course  our players and to prevent similar situations in the future we are planning to change our server provider before the next public playtest.

[h3]Requested Features[/h3]

[b]Prevention of spawn stalking[/b] We are planning on introducing trampler spawning spots - a safer space that will be harder to reach for those who are already on the surface.

[b]Inventory management:[/b] We're adding more options to allow you to more freely manage your orbital storage including the splitting items during the expedition preparation.

[b]Character deletion:[/b] There will be an option to delete characters.

[b]New compartments and trampler customisation:[/b] We are planning to add various structural and functional trampler compartments including: stairs and closed turrets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/66f7cbcc6ee4cfede6fd976d7314ca2973e6b2e1.jpg[/img]

[b]Also, and obviously most importantly:[/b] A Trampler horn is on the way!

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]

We are working hard to address some of the more prominent or commonly reported bugs and issues, here's a list of some of our key focuses at this time:

[list]
[*] Bugged box in hands has been addressed.
[*] Tramplers will not get stuck in the air on spawn.
[*] The trampler will no longer get stuck on rocks or in the ground.
[*] A lot of character movement improvements.
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] All compartments prices will be revised.
[*] Loot balance tweaks are underway.
[*] We are aware of various duping bugs and balance-breaking options, fixing all of them.
[*] Trampler movement and maneuverability balance will be revised. As a part of the new traveling experience we can give you a sneak peek of our new control panel:
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/1697445107bd3e8c861b270b0bf7d462f5ce598e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Anti-cheat[/h3]

We want your experience to be as enjoyable, fair and honest as possible, so we are actively working on implementation of anti-cheat.

[h3]New weapons[/h3]

Some new weapons are under development right now!

Here is a model of a new shotgun:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/6d4cf0680cb94d14ae5a8f94546e3070b9ade11c.jpg[/img]

What other weapons would you like to see come to the game?

[h3]Mines[/h3]

Sneak peek of the naval mine field - a dangerous new zone on Sophie:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/0e1818f73b72823998b7a09670233638ab6f6a97.png[/img]

[h3]Explosive barrels[/h3]

A lot of explosions ahead as these explosive barrels will soon arrive in the game as a new tactical feature. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/1775b7a717aecb19e3837eb2be97c7a306b9591d.png[/img]

[h3]Progression[/h3]

One of the important points of our game design department is progression, and we have a few interesting features in mind regarding this which we're sure you're going to enjoy!

All we can reveal right now is that we are planning a gradual unlocking of trampler compartments. But we'll have more in-depth details on this stuff a little further down the line...

[h3]PvE[/h3]

The most attentive of you already found some PvE on the Demo, more is of course planned, but we don't want to spoil anything just yet... ;)

[h3]And More![/h3]

Lots of features are under development to make your travel more interesting including island activities, desert activities, orbit changes, resource re-balance, items, and more!

Obviously, this is all a fraction of everything going on behind the scenes right now, but we wanted to make sure you were all aware that your feedback has been heard, and that we're committed to making SAND the best experience it can be, alongside all you wonderful folk who joined us for the first step of this journey.

Stay tuned for news on when you can next expect to visit Sophie again, and don't hesitate to share any feedback or suggestions in the comments!

Come and join us on our social media pages to keep yourself up to date with all the news and updates for SAND or join the discussion over on Discord now!

notes.title: The SAND Demo is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/e43143ef1044dbd6e0512deba1ff5f9e18133a32.png[/img]

[quote]Servus Allies!

After a short technical test, we are pleased to welcome you all to the planet of Sophie with the release of the SAND Demo![/quote]

In order to access the Demo, all you need to do is click "Install Demo" below, and it'll be added to your account!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3242130/SAND_Demo/

In this demo, the core gameplay is developed around building Tramplers and using them to explore the planet and fight against other players.

This demo offers just a glimpse of what SAND will become. The full game will be much more expansive, however for this test the goal is to ensure that the player vs player component works well before we continue to both develop existing mechanics and add new ones, such as NPCs, interactive points of interest, new compartments for Tramplers (both for PvP and PvE), new weapons, and different Metas to open new compartments.  

Check out some gameplay footage here:

[previewyoutube=abHXuNB-bks;full][/previewyoutube]

For everyone who played the recent technical test, here's the [b]changelog[/b]:

All progress of current users from the closed demo has been wiped.

Please consider that in the current stage of development, we may have future progress wipes to fix issues and make a better experience for you in the final game.

[h3]Feature[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased amount of available regions.
[*] Trampler decay now starts when the trampler doesn’t have any linked players and if no one is near it.
[*] Reworked visuals for items in hands for first-person and third-person.
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] From now it is possible to proceed to the expedition even if some team member was disconnected during the loading. Disconnected team members can still reconnect.
[*] Refrigerator content will be extracted from now!
[*] Improved finding ground for trampler when walker stuck with feet stuck in the air.
[*] Fixed some inappropriate interactions with objects.
[*] Fixed the 'Put' action being shown on empty shelves when a player has nothing in hands
[*] Potential fix of glitched box images in the air. We continue investigating the issue.
[*] Stability improvements.
[/list]
[h3]Sound[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed trampler clinch sound does not finish.
[*] Tweaks in trampler collision sounds.
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed conditions of various contracts.
[*] Increased capacity of boxes.
[*] Locked box contents tweaks.
[/list]
[quote]Please be aware:

[i]The game is in the early stages of development. The gameplay is not final. There is no PvE in this Demo. Bugs may also occur. And most likely, we will be forced to reset progress alongisde updates and hotfixes.

We look forward to hearing your feedback in the SAND Discord and working with you all to improve the game!

The game may contain content not appropriate for all ages or for viewing at work.[/i][/quote]

Massive thanks to everyone who took part in the Closed Playtest, your feedback and suggestions have been instrumental in helping us improve the game and map out our direction for future developments and we hope to see you all back on Sophie to keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: SAND Playtest Dates Update | Playtest Details
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238322/251404ac8a80594ae764c3f796d418e241f38f6b.png[/img]

[quote]Hello everyone. Maksym here, head of studio at Hologryph, to share some updates on the SAND playtest with you all. [/quote]

[h3]We’ll start things off with some news regarding dates:[/h3]

We've been working hard and diligently on this build since spring, but in our efforts to make sure that you all had the best possible first experience with SAND, we found ourselves going much further in scope than we had planned and creating a lot more work for ourselves than we had initially prepared for. As a result, the playtest build will be much larger in scope than anticipated but we will be slightly delaying the playtest beyond summer to early in the 4th quarter of 2024. 

However, to tide you over in the meantime, we've released a Devlog giving you an exclusive first look at the new trampler editor, featuring some new gameplay footage 👇

[previewyoutube=-vTQROS7sEU;full][/previewyoutube]

For an additional little bit of good news: Almost everything has come together. In its current state, the game is playable, fun and a good representation of our vision and direction for the game. If it weren't for the risk of losing hours of progress due to bugs, we would already be inviting players, but we are working on that now and confident that we will have it fixed soon.

[h3]Now for some information about the playtest itself[/h3]

For the Playtest, we've prepared a build that focuses primarily on PvP, removing the planned PvE elements for the time being. We need your help to ensure that player combat works properly, to find and fix all the bugs, and to take your feedback into account before we use that feedback to integrate alongside the PvE aspects of SAND.

Playtest details:
[list]
[*] You can team up with friends on Steam.
[*] Server worlds are fully procedurally generated (with pre-made POI’s randomly spawned throughout)
[*] We have introduced a full, robust Trampler Editor where you can completely customize the layout, equipment, storage, size, maneuverability and fortification of your vessel.  
[*] The Trampler Editor is fully functional, allowing the captain to build and choose a Trampler for the expedition.
[*] You can also choose a pre-made trampler for your expeditions
[*] On the moon, you can gather resources and search for equipment to complete contracts (missions/tasks) for even more valuable rewards.
[*] Some resources are only accessible through contracts that can be found on the map.
[*] All of this is on a server with a dozen other teams.
[*] Once you feel like you've had enough, head to the extraction point and try to secure the resources you've gathered.
[*] Upon reaching orbit, you can modify your Trampler with use of the resources extracted and your battle experience.
[*] Then, embark on a new expedition.
[/list]

As soon as we achieve and are confident in our client and server stability, we will announce the Playtest dates. Initially, we will invite a limited number of people, and once we’ve got the initial growing pains and prevalent issues resolved, we will open access to everyone who has applied.

Thank you for your understanding, we can’t wait to see you in the realms of Sofia!

Come and join us on our social media pages to keep yourself up to date with all the news and updates for SAND or join the discussion over on Discord now!

Some resources are only accessible through contracts that can be found on the map.
All of this is on a server with a dozen other teams.
Once you feel like you've had enough, head to the extraction point and try to secure the resources you've gathered.
Upon reaching orbit, you can modify your Trampler with use of the resources extracted and your battle experience.
Then, embark on a new expedition.
